doc.title: Emile Barnes and Paul Barnes Interview, 1959-10-01

title: Joining the Tuxedo Band in 1923 under Celestin and Ridgely
summary: Paul joins the Tuxedo Band, with Celestin as leader and Ridgely as manager; the talk touches on the few violinists left and the job at Tranchina's.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: That fellow, Dave Dupas, he was an insurance collector. And he used to worry me, worry me, but John, the Tuxedo Band, that's a great band, and John would... Well, Simon was playing with the Kid René Band, he quit the band and he went with the Tuxedo Band. So Simon and John Marara both went with the Tuxedo Band, and I wanted to get over there. So I left Maple Leaf Band and I joined the Tuxedo Band, that was in 1923. Who was the actual leader?
Celestan or Ridgely? No. Bebe Ridgely. That was the manager of the band.

Yeah. But Celestan was the leader, the trumpet player, he was the leader, but Bebe Ridgely was the manager of the band. He took care of all the business. Did they have a violin in those days? Well, they were just about dying out. Pierron was the only one that I know of, Lef and Robichaux. They were the only ones that I can remember that played in, but all the rest of the head died out by that time. Paul. Do you know of anyone else? I think all of them Paul.
Paul Dominguez. Paul Dominguez. Was he still playing then? Yeah. Well they were the only ones because they were dying out then.
Paul Dominguez, Peter Bauer, and I was on band.

Well that was the year, we played out at Tranchinas out in the lake when I joined Tuxedo Band. We were taking Pierron's band's place. I played a couple of jobs with Pierron's band also. Well Pierron went to New York at that time and we'd taken his place until he came back. We worked there a year.
